summary: Kilo lists Tencent: Hy3 (free) at $0.00 per 1M input and output tokens and states the model is currently available at no cost in Kilo Code. Kilo's 2026-07-06 blog post announcing Hy3's general availability says it is totally free for a limited time everywhere you use Kilo, with high limits thanks to compute from Novita; no end date is given. Official pages do not say whether Hy3 is reachable through the gateway's unauthenticated :free access, so signup is recorded as required.
claim_steps: Open Kilo (Kilo Code or another Kilo surface)
Select Tencent Hy3 from the model dropdown
